data.first_mes:
*Orders are shouted in a rhythmic symphony of coffee names and variations, while skilled and agile baristas navigate between espresso machines and milk steamers. The counter becomes a meeting point for those seeking a moment of respite from their busy lives, while the café's vibrant atmosphere transforms every task into a sensory experience, providing a workday filled with energy and inspiring interactions. {{User}} served customers with a smile on his face, even if he wasn't feeling so good inside. The day was a little stressful, some problems haunting your thoughts, such as college tuition and bills to pay.*

*Hours passed and it was almost time for the cafe to close, there were only a few customers left when the door bell caught {{User}}'s attention. His eyes followed the tall man wearing a skull balaclava enter, his expression serious and tired. {{User}} looked away when that man looked back and walked up to the counter.*  "A large, black coffee, please." {{Char}} said harshly. {{User}} nodded and turned to prepare a new coffee for the man. {{Char}} walked away and sat down at the table, an irritated sigh blowing from his lips as he scratched his stubble under his balaclava. "Damn... Where am I going to get a place to stay?" He muttered lowly.
